work_role.description: The last recorded dispatch configuration, or null when none is known. This record does not establish work-role liveness.

driver.description: The Compute driver it provisions Instances with: the Environment work is provisioned in, read-only.

limit.description: The recorded Active-Work Slot limit, or null when dispatch configuration is unknown.

occupied.description: Every working or trailing Session on the control plane: the pool it counts against is shared by every Organization.

occupants.description: This Organization's working and trailing Sessions, in the order they were enqueued.

elsewhere.description: Occupants of other Organizations, counted and never named.

Occupant.description: A Session holding an Active-Work Slot. A trailing one answered its Turn while work its agent started still runs; it is never among the Waiting Sessions.

limit.description: The Organization's live Instance limit, or null when unbounded.

count.description: The Instances counted against it, idle ones retained for Unpublished Work included.

counted.description: The counted Instances that can be named.

position.description: Global order among eligible requests for an Active-Work Slot, including queued Sessions, Held Messages and first Briefs. Retained while slots are full; null when blocked, not requesting a slot, or dispatch configuration is unknown.

reasons.description: Current blockers and predecessors for this request, computed by the scheduler. Other Organizations are counted without naming their Sessions.

WaitingSession.description: A Session between Turns. Held Messages request an Active-Work Slot and have a global position when eligible.

pending_since.description: When the oldest input held for its next turn arrived, or null while it is only waiting for a turn.

reasons.description: Current blockers and predecessors for this request, computed by the scheduler. Other Organizations are counted without naming their Sessions.

position.description: Global order among eligible requests for an Active-Work Slot, including queued Sessions, Held Messages and first Briefs. Retained while slots are full; null when blocked, not requesting a slot, or dispatch configuration is unknown.

UnbriefedSession.description: A Session preparing or ready for its first Turn. Provisioning is unnumbered; a written Brief competes for an Active-Work Slot once the harness is ready.

preparing.description: The step it is preparing on: provisioning from claim until its supervisor connects, cloning until its checkout is reported, starting_harness until the harness is up, and harness_ready once it is.

pending_since.description: When the oldest message held for its Brief arrived, or null while it holds none.

position.description: Global order among eligible requests for an Active-Work Slot, including queued Sessions, Held Messages and first Briefs. Retained while slots are full; null when blocked, not requesting a slot, or dispatch configuration is unknown.

reasons.description: Current blockers and predecessors for this request, computed by the scheduler. Other Organizations are counted without naming their Sessions.

brief_since.description: When its unstarted Brief was written, once the harness is ready, independently of later Held Messages.

QueueReason.description: One reason a Session has not started, for a Client to phrase.

participant.description: The person releasing it, by the participant name rule. Omitted, the install's Operator; with none named, a 409 `setup_gap` whose step names one.

QueueStanding.description: A Workspace's Session as the queue sees it: queued with a position or reasons, waiting with reasons and held input, or unbriefed with held input.

position.description: Its global place among eligible requests for an Active-Work Slot; null when blocked, not requesting a slot, or dispatch configuration is unknown.

pending_since.description: When the oldest input held for its next turn arrived.

sessions.description: The blocking Sessions that have not ended successfully.

session.description: The Session holding the Profile; null when a non-Session use holds it.

instance.description: The idle Instance being archived, or that dispatch will archive, to make room.

limit.description: The Organization's live Instance limit, reached with no idle Instance known recoverable.
The Active-Work Slot limit, every slot occupied.

sessions.description: Earlier eligible slot requests in this Organization, in global dispatch order.

elsewhere.description: Earlier eligible slot requests in other Organizations, omitted when zero.
